threat_event: Ransomware enters through an OT vendor's always-on remote access and stops picking at the automated distribution centers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two OT vendors with always-on remote access; weak OT segmentation
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D4 distribution center OT and WMS
existing_controls: EDR on WMS servers; manual picking fallback
treatment_plan: Vendor access through group PAM on request; segmentation
owner: Grocery Wholesale security and compliance lead

threat_event: Attackers move from the WMS network into conveyor and refrigeration controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat routes between WMS and OT at 4 of 6 sites
treatment_plan: OT segmentation with an industrial demilitarized zone at each site

threat_event: The central WMS cannot be restored at full volume within the 6-hour RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Restore tested only for one site's data
treatment_plan: Full-volume restore test in the secondary data center

threat_event: A cold chain alarm fails and unsafe food is shipped to stores
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Alarm paths depend on one monitoring server per site
treatment_plan: Redundant alarm paths to the control room and on-call phones

threat_event: An independent grocer's shared portal account is taken over and orders or payments are diverted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 30% of accounts shared among store staff; MFA optional
treatment_plan: Named users per customer; MFA required by 2027-03-31

threat_event: A malicious script on the portal invoice payment page skims independent grocers' card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Page loads the shared tag container; no tamper detection
treatment_plan: Remove the shared container from the page; add tamper detection

threat_event: The division cannot produce traceability records within 24 hours of an FDA request
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Lot records split across WMS and ERP
existing_controls: Daily export to the backup vault

threat_event: The EDI network provider has an outage and supplier orders stop
Business email compromise diverts supplier payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank detail changes accepted by email
existing_controls: Call-back verification for changes above a threshold
treatment_plan: Call-back for every bank detail change

threat_event: The telematics or TMS service is compromised and dispatch is disrupted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Telematics vendor has access to routing data

threat_event: Unknown OT devices with default credentials stay exposed at two distribution centers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT asset inventory at 2 of 6 sites
treatment_plan: Passive OT discovery and inventory at the remaining sites

threat_event: A portal defect shows one independent grocer another customer's prices or orders
existing_controls: Customer ID checks in code reviews
treatment_plan: Automated cross-customer access tests in every release

threat_event: Commitments made to independent grocers for a SOC 2 report are not met by the end of 2027
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance of group controls not documented; portal controls not yet evidenced
treatment_plan: Readiness plan in P09; Type 1 in 2027

threat_event: A hurricane closes Florida distribution centers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 6 distribution centers are in Florida
existing_controls: Cross-docking plan through Georgia and Alabama
treatment_plan: Joint exercise with retail each May

threat_event: Warehouse labor optimization metrics are used unfairly in discipline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Productivity data shown to supervisors daily
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Grocery Wholesale security and compliance lead (Low)
owner: Grocery Wholesale security and compliance lead

threat_event: An employee takes customer price lists to a competitor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Price files downloadable by account managers
